stories.title: CPython flaw exposes AI inference servers to sandbox escape attacks
stories.why: A memory-safety flaw in CPython can allow malicious AI model templates to escape code sandboxes and execute arbitrary code inside inference servers, according to security researchers at RunSybil.

stories.title: Binance heist is stark example of AI governance gaps and basic security failures
stories.why: A chain of avoidable technical and human security failures enabled the largest crypto heist on record, the theft of approximately $6.34 billion from Binance .

stories.title: OpenAI's new GPT-6 Cyber AI finds 81 Firefox flaws, 948 Linux bugs
stories.why: OpenAI has revealed GPT-6 Cyber, a new artificial intelligence model that has discovered 81 previously unknown high-severity Firefox vulnerabilities and developed working exploits for 948 distinct Linux kernel flaws.

stories.title: Researchers Bypass ChatGPT Lockdown Mode to Exfiltrate Chats Without User Interaction
stories.why: Cybersecurity researchers have disclosed details of a now-patched vulnerability that could be exploited to bypass Lockdown Mode protections in OpenAI ChatGPT.

stories.title: OpenAI Model Wrote Its Own Network Code to Get Around Sandbox Restrictions
stories.why: After its sandbox proxy failed, an internal OpenAI model crafted raw packets and probed AWS services trying to reach the internet.
